variants.prompt: Cho tứ diện <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mi>C</mi><mi>D</mi></mrow></semantics></math>. Gọi <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>M</mi></mrow></semantics></math>, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>N</mi></mrow></semantics></math> lần lượt là trung điểm <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>D</mi></mrow></semantics></math>, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>C</mi></mrow></semantics></math>; <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>G</mi></mrow></semantics></math> là trọng tâm tam giác <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>C</mi><mi>D</mi></mrow></semantics></math>. Khi đó <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mover><mrow><mi>M</mi><mi>N</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mi>m</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mover><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mover><mrow><mi>D</mi><mi>C</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math> và <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mover><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mover><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>C</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mover><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>D</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mi>n</mi><mover><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>G</mi></mrow><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover></mrow></semantics></math>. Giá trị của biểu thức <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>m</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>n</mi></mrow></semantics></math> bằng
variants.solution:
Ta có AB→+DC→=2MN→ nên m=12.
Do G là trọng tâm tam giác BCD nên AB→+AC→+AD→=3AG→, suy ra n=3.
Vậy 2m+n=4.
